resources.string: Finish matchmaking, your match, friend room or practice request first.

Guest progress can be lost if app data is cleared or the device is lost. Bind an email to recover it. Existing-account login does not merge guest coins or rating. Offline progress and coins stay on this device.
Online saving requires a connection and creates or recovers your guest. Changing your avatar does not change your nickname.
Log out and start a new guest
Guest coins and rating are not merged with the account you log in to. The previous guest is securely retained for explicit recovery. Offline data stays unchanged.
The server session must be revoked successfully before local credentials change. You will start a new guest. Bind your guest first to avoid losing access. Offline data is not deleted.
Your account enters a 7-day pending deletion period and sessions end. Use Cancel pending deletion with your email and password within 7 days. Offline data is not deleted.
Remove expired identity from this device only
This does not log out server sessions. The identity is already expired or revoked. Removing it starts a new guest; guest progress may no longer be recoverable. Offline data stays unchanged.
Only the saved guest secret is used. A response with a different user ID is rejected. If you just bound an email, log in with that email instead.

WS/HTTP accounts are temporarily allowed when the server enables PK_AUTH_ALLOW_HTTP=true. Cleartext connections do not encrypt account data and are for temporary compatibility only; WSS/HTTPS is recommended.
Your verified email account can be used on other devices. Online coins and rating belong to this account; offline progress remains separate.
Trust HTTPS address and migrate old guest

Old environment: %1$s
Trusted target: %2$s
Old user ID: %3$d
Your old credential will be sent to this target for one migration attempt. Only confirm if you trust its operator. Failure retains the old credential and environment; success preserves your user ID.
Use 2–16 Unicode characters. Ordinary internal spaces are allowed; invisible characters and controls are not.
Enter a nickname of 2–16 characters, without controls or invisible characters. Ordinary internal spaces are allowed.
Nickname can be changed after %1$s. You can still change your avatar.
Your nickname is still on cooldown. Keep it unchanged to save only your avatar; refresh your profile for the latest time.
This nickname was not approved. Try another. Your profile was not saved.
Nickname review is pending. Your profile was not saved. Keep your draft and try again later.
Nickname review is temporarily unavailable. Your profile was not saved. Keep your draft and try again later.
You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
Device-only safe default. Offline progress is unchanged.
Saving requires a connection and will create or recover your guest first. The server chooses a new guest’s default nickname. Custom names require review.
Could not verify the returned profile. Nothing was saved locally. Keep your draft and refresh to check the server.
Network or secure storage failed. Keep your draft and retry; if a request timed out, refresh to check its status. Do not clear app data.
